name: StraddleqTrail
summary: StraddleqTrail is a breakout Expert Advisor that places straddle (buy stop and sell stop) pending orders around a defined price level or range, then trails the stop-loss as price moves in favor. It captures breakout momentum from consolidation periods by using pending orders on both sides and managing positions with a trailing stop mechanism.
summary_zh: StraddleqTrail是一个突破型EA，在设定的价格水平或区间上下方放置买入止损和卖出止损挂单（Straddle策略），然后在价格有利方向移动时跟踪止损。它通过在盘整区间两侧布设挂单来捕捉突破动量，并使用跟踪止损机制管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的Straddle突破策略，在市场盘整期间在价格上下方同时放置买入止损和卖出止损挂单，等待价格突破任一方向后入场。入场条件是价格突破预设的区间上下轨，触发挂单成交。出场条件包括跟踪止损（Trailing Stop）在价格有利移动时逐步上移止损位保护利润，以及达到止损或止盈目标时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许自定义手数设置，但未见明显的动态仓位调整或基于资金的仓位计算逻辑。资金管理依赖用户手动设置合理的止损和手数参数，缺少自动化的风险控制机制。策略在重大新闻或事件驱动行情中表现最佳，但在震荡市中可能因反复触发挂单而产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic Straddle breakout strategy, placing both buy stop and sell stop pending orders above and below a price range during market consolidation, waiting for a breakout in either direction to trigger entry. Entry conditions are based on price breaking through predefined upper or lower boundaries, activating the corresponding pending order. Exit conditions include a trailing stop mechanism that progressively moves the stop-loss in the direction of profit as price moves favorably, as well as hitting fixed stop-loss or take-profit targets. Position sizing relies on user-configured lot sizes without visible dynamic position sizing or equity-based calculation logic. Money management depends on the user manually setting reasonable stop-loss and lot parameters, lacking automated risk control mechanisms. The strategy performs optimally during major news events or event-driven volatility, but may suffer consecutive losses in choppy/ranging markets due to repeated pending order triggers.

parameters.name: StraddleDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价格的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points; 0 to disable

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 跟踪止损调整步长点数
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop adjustment step in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: Straddle策略能捕捉任一方向的突破行情，不会错过单边走势
跟踪止损机制有效锁定浮动利润，让盈利单充分奔跑
挂单方式入场避免了情绪化交易，执行纪律性强
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强，便于优化和回测
适用于重大新闻事件前后部署，能在高波动行情中获利
pros_en: Straddle strategy captures breakouts in either direction, ensuring no major trending move is missed
Trailing stop mechanism effectively locks in floating profits while allowing winning trades to run
Pending order entries eliminate emotional trading decisions and ensure disciplined execution
Strategy logic is clear and understandable with highly adjustable parameters for optimization and backtesting
Well-suited for deployment around major news events, capitalizing on high-volatility moves
cons: 在震荡行情中两侧挂单可能被反复触发止损，造成连续亏损（Whipsaw风险）
缺少动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金自动调整手数
未包含点差过滤机制，大点差环境下入场成本可能过高
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复下单
无时间过滤功能，无法限制在特定交易时段运行
cons_en: In choppy/ranging markets, both sides of pending orders may be repeatedly triggered resulting in consecutive losses (whipsaw risk)
Lacks dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account equity
No spread filter mechanism means entry costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
Missing new bar check could lead to repeated order placement on the same candle
No time filter functionality to restrict trading to specific sessions or time windows
improvements: 添加震荡行情过滤器（如ATR或ADX指标），在低波动盘整期减少或暂停挂单以避免Whipsaw亏损
实现基于账户净值百分比的动态仓位计算，并根据点差和滑点设置入场过滤条件
improvements_en: Add a volatility/filter (e.g., ATR or ADX indicator) to reduce or pause pending orders during low-volatility choppy periods to avoid whipsaw losses
Implement equity-based dynamic position sizing and add spread/slippage filter conditions before order placement

risk_points: Straddle策略在震荡市中双方向挂单可能同时被止损，造成双倍亏损
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下止损距离可能不足以覆盖交易成本
无新K线检查和持仓检查，存在重复下单风险
跟踪止损在剧烈跳空行情中可能无法有效保护利润
risk_points_en: Straddle strategy risks both pending orders being stopped out in choppy markets, resulting in double losses
No spread filter means stop-loss distances may be insufficient to cover trading costs in high-spread conditions
Missing new bar check and position check poses risk of duplicate order placement
Trailing stop may fail to effectively protect profits during severe gap events

summary_en: StraddleqTrail is a breakout Expert Advisor that places straddle (buy stop and sell stop) pending orders around a defined price level or range, then trails the stop-loss as price moves in favor. It captures breakout momentum from consolidation periods by using pending orders on both sides and managing positions with a trailing stop mechanism.
